newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania 1996 inflation 13.1 pct, official says.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania 1996 inflation 13.1 pct, official says.

text.p: Lithuania's December year-on-year inflation rate was 13.1 percent after a month-on-month price rise of 0.9 percent, the head of the country's statistics department said on Monday.
The head of the statistics office, Kestutis Zaborskas, gave the figures before an official announcement due on Tuesday of last year's inflation.
"The December inflation rate was 0.9 percent," Zaborskas told Reuters, adding that year-on-year inflation was 13.1 percent.
Inflation has more than halved since the end of last year, when it stood at 35.7 percent.
November inflation was 1.1 percent month-on-month for a 15.0-percent year-on-year figure.
Inflation in the rest of the Baltic states has also fallen and was 0.6 percent in Estonia in November for a year-on-year figure of 16.4 percent that month.
In Latvia, inflation was 0.8 percent month-on-month in November for a 14.4-percent yearly rise.
